meta.title: The Twelve Compounding Closed Loops
meta.subtitle: Shopify · Klaviyo · Meta / Instagram · Amazon Marketplace
meta.source: playbooks--001.parker.docx — Closed-Loop Integration Architecture (Michael Rinaldi, Solutions Engineering, smmt)
meta.tagline: A closed loop means data leaves one system, is acted on in another, and returns as a converted customer or enriched signal — so each cycle improves the next.
principles: The walled-garden rule — audience lists only ever flow outbound to Meta; loops close on converters and aggregate signal, never on extracted membership.
Email is the universal join key — Shopify email ↔ Klaviyo email ↔ Meta EMAIL_SHA256; build canonicalization once.
Lookalike expansion is a Meta-side primitive — we supply the seed, Meta expands it.
Loops close on signal, not symmetry — the return leg is a different mechanism than the outbound leg.
The Amazon wall is stricter — no email egress; lists feed inbound only, engagement happens on-platform.

loops.title: Attribution → Segment → Re-seed
loops.objective: For every order, capture its marketing attribution, classify the customer into an “acquired via {channel}” cohort, sync high-value cohorts to Meta as custom audiences, spawn lookalikes, and let resulting new orders re-enter with their own UTM — compounding seed quality each cycle.
legs: Read attribution — fetch order.customerJourneySummary via Admin GraphQL (poll until ready)
Classify by UTM source/medium/campaign; write back tag acq:{source}:{campaign} + Klaviyo event
Define the seed segment in Klaviyo (acquisition AND high predicted CLV)
Sync segment → Meta Custom Audience (email-only, one-way)
Create Lookalike → attach to FB + IG ad sets with UTM-tagged URLs
New lookalike shoppers purchase → orders/paid fires → loop compounds
loops.edge: customerJourneySummary.ready may be false — poll with backoff; null UTMs route to a “direct/unknown” bucket, never dropped.

loops.title: Purchase → Post-purchase → Repurchase
loops.objective: Convert a first purchase into a retention / repurchase cycle.
legs: Klaviyo flow on Placed Order — thank-you → cross-sell → replenishment timer
Flow generates a unique Shopify discount code synced into the email
Redemption creates a new orders/paid → re-enter
loops.edge: Coupon collision/reuse; refunded orders (refunds/create) must exit the flow; subscription orders may double-fire.

loops.title: Abandoned-checkout multi-channel recovery
loops.objective: Recover abandoned checkouts across email/SMS and paid retargeting simultaneously.
loops.trigger: Shopify checkouts/create + checkouts/update → Klaviyo Started Checkout
legs: Klaviyo abandoned-cart flow (email + SMS)
Cart-abandoner segment → Meta custom audience for FB/IG retargeting
Recovery → orders/paid
On purchase, exit both the flow and (next sync) the audience
loops.edge: 24h relative-time lag; gate with “has not placed order since checkout”; SMS consent required before the SMS leg.

loops.title: Lead-gen nurture (Meta/IG → customer)
loops.objective: Capture paid-social leads, nurture to first purchase, attribute back, and re-seed acquisition.
legs: Klaviyo native lead-ad sync drops the lead into a Klaviyo list (real-time)
Klaviyo nurture flow
Conversion → Shopify customer/order
Order UTM (Loop 1) attributes the campaign; converters feed the high-LTV seed
loops.edge: Lead quality/spam — add validation + double opt-in; long B2B cycles need lead-status sync; report offline CRM-closed deals via CAPI offline.

loops.title: Server-side conversion optimization (CAPI)
loops.objective: Feed clean server-side conversion signal to Meta’s optimizer to improve delivery and resilience to ad-blockers / iOS.
legs: Shopify “Facebook & Instagram by Meta” channel (data sharing = Maximum) emits CAPI Purchase server-side
Pixel emits the browser counterpart
Both carry the same event_id → Meta dedups
Optimizer improves who-sees-ads → more conversions → more events
loops.edge: event_id divergence is the dominant failure — pick ONE authoritative CAPI sender; verify in Events Manager Test Events.

loops.title: Suppression / exclusion hygiene
loops.objective: Stop paying to prospect existing customers; concentrate spend on net-new.
legs: Recent purchasers + existing-customer segment → Meta exclusion custom audience
Prospecting/lookalike ad sets exclude it
Net-new converts → enters Shopify/Klaviyo → added to suppression next cycle
loops.edge: Stale exclusions (sync lag); opt-outs must also be removed from inclusion audiences (Loop 8); attach exclusion to the right ad sets.

loops.title: Predictive value tiering
loops.objective: Let Klaviyo’s ML route customers to acquisition vs retention treatments, and re-score on outcome.
loops.trigger: Klaviyo predictive analytics refresh (CLV, churn-risk, next-order date)
legs: High-predicted-CLV segment → Meta lookalike seed + VIP flow
High-churn-risk segment → win-back flow + Meta retargeting
Outcomes (purchase / lapse) update predictions → re-tier
loops.edge: Predictions need order history (cold-start); small B2B lists may not produce stable predictions; avoid daily audience thrash.

loops.title: Consent / identity propagation
loops.objective: Keep consent and identity state consistent across Shopify/Klaviyo/Meta (GDPR/CCPA + Meta obligations).
loops.trigger: Klaviyo consent events (unsubscribe, SMS opt-out); Shopify customers/update
legs: Consent webhook → remove profile from mapped Meta custom audiences + flag in Shopify + suppress in Klaviyo
Shopify profile change → update Klaviyo profile → re-sync to Meta next cycle
loops.edge: System-webhook tier gating (Advanced KDP/partner); Meta requires removing opted-out users; email/phone changes orphan prior hashes (re-hash + re-sync).

loops.title: Off-Amazon demand → Amazon conversion
loops.objective: Prove and grow the on-Amazon ROI of off-Amazon demand, then recycle the signal.
loops.trigger: smmt-run Meta/IG + email (and Shopify) campaigns pointing at Amazon listings / Store
legs: Wrap destination URLs with Amazon Attribution tags (Ads API)
Amazon measures clicks → DPV → ATC → purchase + new-to-brand (14-day last-touch)
smmt pulls Attribution reports, mirrors conversions to Meta CAPI offline, reallocates spend
Non-converters retargeted via Amazon DSP; Brand Referral Bonus returns ~10% of attributed sales
loops.edge: No pixel on Amazon → tag hygiene is everything; 14-day last-touch only; requires Brand Registry + Professional Seller.

loops.title: Cross-platform syndication & lookalike fan-out
loops.short: Cross-platform syndication & lookalike fan-out — the reuse engine
loops.objective: Make one first-party audience reusable everywhere and let every platform expand it.
loops.trigger: Any change to smmt’s canonical audience (new orders, Klaviyo segment / predictive updates)
legs: smmt holds the canonical first-party audience (normalized + hashed)
Fan it out to a Meta Custom Audience AND an Amazon Advertiser Audience (+ AMC)
Build lookalikes natively on both Meta and Amazon DSP
Converters land back in Shopify (email-joinable) or Amazon (measured via Loop 9) — seed grows each cycle
loops.edge: Match rates differ (40–70%); Amazon lookalike seed ≥ 1,000 matched; Amazon converters cannot be email-joined; keep suppression in sync (Loop 6).

loops.title: Amazon-native retention & win-back
loops.objective: Retain and win back Amazon customers you cannot email — entirely Amazon-side.
loops.trigger: Amazon purchase / brand follow (and Brand Tailored Promotions audience membership)
legs: Enroll repeat-purchase ASINs in Subscribe & Save (recurring revenue)
Issue Brand Tailored Promotions %-off codes to Amazon-built segments (Repeat, High-Spend, Cart Abandoners, At-Risk, Brand Followers)
Repurchase re-enrolls the customer into the relevant segments
loops.edge: No PII/email export — engagement is Amazon on-platform only; discount funds the promo (watch margin); audiences overlap, one promo per purchase.

loops.title: Unified profile & insight enrichment
loops.objective: Unify signal across all four systems into reusable insight that sharpens targeting everywhere.
loops.trigger: Ongoing ingestion of Shopify orders, Klaviyo profiles/events/predictions, Meta delivery + CAPI, Amazon SP-API + Ads/AMC signals
legs: smmt ingests and resolves identity where possible (email graph + pseudonymous Amazon aggregates)
AMC clean-room SQL joins first-party data with Amazon signals to reveal cross-channel journeys
Unified profiles + predictive inform which segments and lookalikes to build
Better segments feed Loops 1 / 7 / 10 → improved targeting lifts the signal flowing back in
loops.edge: Amazon identity is a hard boundary — aggregate/pseudonymous only; AMC outputs are privacy-thresholded; do not over-claim unified identity.
